headline: Sudan Increases Customs Exchange Rate by 16% to 6,539 Pounds Per Dollar
summary: Sudan raised its official customs dollar exchange rate by 16.1% to 6,539 pounds, increasing import duties for commercial goods.
why: Customs exchange rates directly alter import costs and domestic inflation in developing trade regimes.

impacts.name: Sudan
impacts.why: Government adjusted official exchange valuation applied to import tariffs.
